issues.title: TCP urgent-data receive-backpressure
issues.root_cause: Exceptions were monitored even when receive monitoring was paused, allowing urgent data to trigger more reads.
issues.corrected_invariant: select exception monitoring requires a receive request; send-only/paused sockets cannot get urgent-data ERR readiness.

issues.title: Persistently paused send buffers
issues.root_cause: Pre-BIP31 peers could remain send-paused while additional announcements accumulated, without an independent pause deadline.
issues.corrected_invariant: Both pause writers record only false-to-true transitions atomically; continued pause beyond the existing twenty-minute interval triggers disconnect, independent of protocol version or transport.

issues.title: Block/undo absolute file positions
issues.root_cause: 32-bit absolute offsets and undo accounting could wrap; Windows long-based seek/truncate operations could not represent large positions.
issues.corrected_invariant: Absolute positions/accounting are uint64_t; seeks, truncation and allocation use checked wide operations; existing VARINT bytes remain identical for old valid values.
